name: Bricksed – Bricks Builder Templates, Layouts & Components Library
author: Bricksed

sections.description:
Bricksed is a template and component library for Bricks Builder. Open the Bricksed panel in the Bricks editor, pick a hero section, a pricing table, a gallery, a header or a footer, and click it: it lands on the canvas as native Bricks elements with clean global classes, ready to edit like anything you built yourself.

No shortcodes, no locked widgets, no extra page builder on top of Bricks. Every item is regular Bricks content, so your pages keep working even if you deactivate the plugin.

Free Bricks templates and components in this plugin

This free version ships 30 hand-built Bricks Builder items:

  • Features: Banded Header Feature Grid, Compact Icon Feature Grid, Floating Label Image Grid, Staggered Logo Wall Feature
  • Buttons: Aurora Edge Button, Diagonal Shine Button, Magnetic Pull Button
  • Footers: Accordion Link Footer, Big Type Contact Footer, Open Status Studio Footer
  • Galleries: Drifting Wall Gallery, Filterable Project Grid, Mosaic Lightbox Gallery
  • Accordions: Editorial Accordion Rows, Filterable FAQ Accordion
  • Call to action: Launch Odometer CTA, Nightfall Mosaic CTA
  • Cards: Adaptive Theme Pricing Cards, Circle Fill Hover Card
  • Headers and navigation: Auto-Hide Pill Navbar, Bloom Menu Header
  • Hero: Agency Dark Hero, Hero Split
  • Sliders: Auto-Binding CMS Carousel, Click-Lock Marquee Bar
  • Utilities: Avatar Stack, Copy Command Chip
  • FAQ: Gliding Tab FAQ
  • Pricing: Billing Toggle Pricing
  • Team cards: Flip Bio Team Grid

Why Bricksed

  • Native Bricks elements. Items insert as Bricks sections, containers, blocks, headings, buttons and images, plus Bricks components with properties you edit in the Bricks panel.
  • Built for Automatic.css (ACSS). Colours, spacing and typography use Automatic.css tokens, with built-in fallbacks so every item also looks right without ACSS.
  • Clean BEM class names. Readable global classes you can restyle once for the whole site.
  • Responsive and accessible. Semantic HTML, keyboard focus styles, reduced-motion support and layouts that hold from phone to wide screen.
  • Fast to browse. Search by name or tag, filter by type and category, preview any item before you insert it, switch between tree and grid view.
  • One click to insert. Click an item and it is on the canvas, in place, ready to edit.
  • Lightweight. The library panel loads only in the Bricks editor. On the front end, Bricksed adds only the small scripts the items you placed need.

Bricksed Pro: the full Bricks Builder library

Bricksed Pro unlocks the whole library, 785 Bricks Builder items, plus the Pro tools:

  • 337 layouts: Hero (59), Galleries (37), Sliders (36), Content (30), Grids (26), Testimonials (24), Headers and navigation (19), Team cards (14), Footers (12), Homepage (12), Blog (11), Features (8), Interactive (8), Services (6), How it works (5), Portfolio (5), Contact (4), FAQ (4), Headings (4), Pricing (4), Forms (3), Utilities (3), Call to action (2), Integrations (1)
  • 204 components: Cards (70), Sliders (65), Galleries (40), Interactive (19), Accordions (3), Buttons (2), Utilities (2), Headings (1), Navigation (1), Tabs (1)
  • 236 elements: Text (100), Buttons (73), Cards (35), Utilities (17), Fields (6), Icons (2), Pagination (2), Backgrounds (1)

  • 8 templates: Landing page (6), Creative (1), Portfolio (1)

  • 2 complete websites to import: pages, dynamic templates (single post, archive, 404), custom post types, fields, forms and design, imported step by step.

  • 50 brand kits for Automatic.css: a complete look (palette, fonts, radius, spacing) applied to the whole site in one click.
  • 80 animations: drag an entrance, scroll or hover animation onto any Bricks element and tune it in the panel.
  • Facet Pro: filters, search and sorting for posts, products and your own content, built for you from a few questions.
  • Save to Bricksed, folders, import and export: keep your own sections next to the library and move them between sites.
  • User access and white label: decide who sees Bricksed and rename it in the builder for your clients.
  • New patterns every week and automatic updates, on a lifetime license for unlimited sites.

Buying Pro gives you the Pro plugin on bricksed.com. It installs over this free version; your settings and inserted items stay.

Bricksed is an independent product. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by the makers of Bricks Builder.

External services

Bricksed itself does not send any data from your site.

  • Unsplash (images.unsplash.com). Some library items use photos hosted by Unsplash. When you insert such an item, the photo stays hosted by Unsplash: the builder and your visitors’ browsers load it from images.unsplash.com, which receives their IP address and browser details like any image request. Replace the photo with one from your media library to stop this. Unsplash terms and privacy policy.
  • SVG icons by URL. When an inserted item refers to an SVG icon by its web address, Bricksed downloads that file once on your server to place the icon inline. The free items do not use any.
  • bricksed.com. The plugin links to bricksed.com for documentation and for buying Bricksed Pro. Nothing is sent until you click such a link. bricksed.com terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure the Bricks theme (Bricks Builder) is installed and active.
  2. Install Bricksed from Plugins › Add New (search for “Bricksed”), or upload the bricksed folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Bricksed.
  4. Open any page in the Bricks builder and click the Bricksed icon in the toolbar.
  5. Pick an item and click it to place it on the canvas.

Library settings live under the Bricksed menu in wp-admin.
sections.faq:
Is Bricksed a Bricks Builder template library?

Yes. Bricksed adds a library of Bricks Builder templates, layouts, components and elements to the Bricks editor. Items insert as native Bricks elements.

Do I need Bricks Builder?

Yes. Bricksed is made for the Bricks Builder editor and does nothing without the Bricks theme.

Do I need Automatic.css (ACSS)?

No. Items use Automatic.css tokens when ACSS is active and fall back to built-in values when it is not.

Are the templates responsive?

Yes. Every item is built to work from phone to wide screen and uses semantic, accessible markup.

Can I use the free items on client sites?

Yes. Bricksed is GPL: use the free items on as many sites as you like, personal or client work.

What happens to my pages if I deactivate Bricksed?

Nothing. Inserted items are regular Bricks elements and global classes stored in your site.

What is in Bricksed Pro?

The full library of 785 Bricks Builder items, complete websites to import, brand kits, animations, Facet Pro, Save to Bricksed and weekly updates. See the Pro section above or bricksed.com/pricing.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Buy Bricksed Pro on bricksed.com, download the Pro plugin from your account and upload it under Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin. It replaces this free version in place.

  • The Mega Menu element of earlier versions is no longer part of Bricksed.

1.0.1

  • Mega Menu / Mobile Menu element for Bricks Builder.
